6.358 rsMissingDefaultRelationshipJoinCondition
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsMissingDefaultRelationshipJoinCondition is a critical error that will occur when a DataSet specifies a
DefaultRelationship for a RelatedDataSet that does not contain at least one JoinCondition.
